No npm publication or Nightly qualification is claimed.

Reviewed allowance capture from the protected account route through bounded cross-process JSON publication, 30-day pruning on capture and hourly observations, with no raw responses/identity values retained. Reviewed opaque applied-profile metadata through owner-scoped epoch-fenced SQLite reads, receipts and profile filters; legacy/source-home receipts stay unknown. Strict SDK and UI queries partition scope/profile, hide on authority loss, keep cost currencies and reported/estimated measures separate. Real mutation of the epoch fence failed the intended unknown-turn assertion and restored green. Independent review found identity ordering and configured-profile fallback gaps; route-entry ordering and typed refusal repairs are verified. Browser fixtures are not live or native delivery proof.
